_comment: Template for usage_counters/{YYYY-MM} documents. Key format: '2026-08'
_usage: A new document matching this shape is created by the dispatch Cloud Function at the start of each calendar month when no document yet exists for that month.
_softCapOlaMaps_note: Ola Maps free tier is 5M calls/month. Soft cap at 4.5M (90%) so the circuit breaker trips before the limit, giving headroom for in-flight requests.
_softCapWhatsapp_note: Conservative soft cap on business-initiated WhatsApp template sends per month. Adjust based on observed usage and Meta's template messaging limits for your account tier.
_circuit_breaker_note: When olaMapsMatrixCalls >= softCapOlaMaps, dispatch logic degrades gracefully (falls back to Haversine-only selection). This is checked at the top of the dispatch Cloud Function. See Phase 4.
